name: Last Stand Phalanx [Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
When battling the terrifying hordes of enemies, you find strength in your shield brothers and sisters.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +3, good alignment.

Benefit(s): You grant a sacred bonus to your adjacent allies AC against the attacks of evil creatures and a sacred bonus to saves against the spells and abilities of evil creatures equal to the number of adjacent allies who also have this feat including yourself.
